issues.description: pkg_waitfor fails to clear pc->pkc_buf on excess message length, causing subsequent pkg_close to call free on caller stack memory.
issues.verification_test: Minimal isolated test connecting pkg_pair, sending 32-byte packet, reading with 16-byte stack buffer via pkg_waitfor, and checking pkc_buf pointer.
issues.test_result: Confirmed: pkc_buf retains dangling pointer 0x16b29a300 to caller stack frame; subsequent pkg_close invokes free() on stack memory causing abort.
issues.fix_description: Reset connection buffer pointer and length to 0/-1 upon truncated packet in pkg_waitfor
issues.commit_message: libpkg: clear connection buffer on truncated pkg_waitfor and null-return on failed bwaitfor

issues.description: pkg_bwaitfor returns uninitialized heap buffer instead of NULL when network read fails or disconnects prematurely.
issues.verification_test: Sent 1024-byte packet header followed by immediate EOF, then called pkg_bwaitfor.
issues.test_result: Confirmed: pkg_bwaitfor logged _pkg_inget 1024 gave 0 but still returned non-NULL heap buffer containing uninitialized memory instead of NULL.
issues.fix_description: Free allocated buffer, reset connection pointers, and return NULL on read failure in pkg_bwaitfor
issues.commit_message: libpkg: clear connection buffer on truncated pkg_waitfor and null-return on failed bwaitfor

issues.description: PKGServer destructor unconditionally dereferences NULL client pointer and frees uninitialized pkc_inbuf.
fbserv packet handlers fail to validate packet payload length against pixel count before calling fb_write, causing heap out-of-bounds read.
issues.verification_test: Constructed packet with num=100 (300 bytes needed) but pkc_len=12.
issues.test_result: Confirmed: handlers read past allocated buffer on heap without verifying pcp->pkc_len >= header + pixel payload length.
issues.fix_description: Add length validation against expected header and pixel payload sizes across fb_write, fb_writerect, fb_bwwriterect, fb_open, fb_clear, fb_setcursor, fb_view, fb_wmap, and fb_help
issues.commit_message: fbserv: validate packet lengths and prevent integer overflow in rectangle handlers

issues.description: Integer multiplication overflow in width*height in fb_readrect and fb_bwreadrect leads to heap buffer overflow during pixel read.
issues.verification_test: Evaluated 32-bit int multiplication with boundary dimensions (65536*65536) and negative inputs.
issues.test_result: Confirmed: width*height wraps to 0 in 32-bit arithmetic bypassing realloc and causing heap overflow, and negative dimensions wrap to huge size_t.
issues.fix_description: Clamp rectangular dimensions to 8192 and perform 64-bit unsigned bounds checks to prevent 32-bit integer multiplication overflow in fb_readrect and fb_bwreadrect
issues.commit_message: fbserv: validate packet lengths and prevent integer overflow in rectangle handlers

issues.description: ph_lines fails to validate pixel range bounds, causing signed integer underflow in (b-a+1)*3 to wrap to huge size_t in pkg_2send, triggering out-of-bounds heap reads, and leaks buffer.
issues.verification_test: Evaluated boundary arithmetic where b < a in ph_lines (e.g. a=10, b=5)
issues.test_result: Confirmed: (b-a+1)*3 produces negative signed value -12, which wraps to (size_t)18446744073709551604 when passed as len2 to pkg_2send, triggering heap out-of-bounds read.
issues.fix_description: Validate pixel range [a..b] to ensure a >= 0, b >= a, and (b-a+1) <= srv_scanlen; remove double free of ext and free buf across all return paths
issues.commit_message: rtsrv: validate pixel range and free buffer in ph_lines

issues.category: Unhandled Input Validation / Denial of Service
issues.description: ph_pixels parses incoming MSG_PIXELS without checking packet length or magic header, allowing malformed network packets to trigger out-of-bounds reads or terminate remrt via bu_bomb.
issues.verification_test: Constructed 4-byte buffer without magic/length headers and passed to bu_struct_wrap_buf as in ph_pixels
issues.test_result: Confirmed: bu_struct_wrap_buf triggers bu_bomb('bad getput buffer'), immediately terminating the process with an abort.
issues.fix_description: Validate packet length >= 8, magic number, and struct length before calling bu_struct_wrap_buf in ph_pixels
issues.commit_message: remrt: validate packet length and struct header in ph_pixels

issues.description: bu_struct_wrap_buf and PARSE_CK_GETPUT do not verify buffer length is at least 8 bytes, causing negative index access and out-of-bounds read on buffers with small or zero length.
issues.verification_test: Executed bu_struct_wrap_buf and bu_struct_import on buffer with encoded length 0
issues.test_result: Confirmed: len - 2 evaluates to negative index -2 (or 18446744073709551614 when cast to size_t), accessing memory prior to buffer or wrapping 64-bit address space.
issues.fix_description: Ensure buffer length and encoded length are at least 8 bytes in bu_struct_wrap_buf and PARSE_CK_GETPUT to avoid buffer underflow
issues.commit_message: libbu: validate buffer length in parse macros to prevent underflow

issues.description: vls_vprintf uses bitwise XOR (^=) instead of bitwise AND NOT (&= ~) to clear length modifiers, corrupting flags and causing incorrect type extraction from va_list.
issues.verification_test: Called handle_format_part with 'h' and checked f.flags
issues.test_result: Confirmed: f.flags was corrupted to 0x00ff (ALL_LENGTHMODS) instead of 0x0001 (SHORTINT) due to ^= ALL_LENGTHMODS on initial 0 value, causing LONG_INT branch to take precedence in va_arg extraction.
issues.fix_description: Clear previous length modifiers using &= ~ALL_LENGTHMODS instead of bitwise XOR (^=) in handle_format_part
issues.commit_message: libbu: clear length modifiers properly in vls_vprintf

issues.description: bu_vls_substr calls bu_vls_putc with NUL, embedding an unwanted NUL byte and off-by-one corrupting vls_len.
issues.verification_test: Extracted 5 characters using bu_vls_substr from string 'hello world'
issues.test_result: Confirmed: dest->vls_len was 6 instead of 5 due to extraneous bu_vls_putc(dest, '\0') call.
issues.fix_description: Remove extraneous bu_vls_putc(dest, '\0') from bu_vls_substr and fix CRLF stripping in bu_vls_gets
issues.commit_message: libbu: fix off-by-one length in bu_vls_substr and crlf handling in bu_vls_gets

issues.description: alloc() and bu_pool_alloc() lack integer multiplication overflow checks on cnt*size, which can cause undersized memory allocations and subsequent heap buffer overflows.
issues.verification_test: Allocated with cnt=SIZE_MAX/2, sz=4 in bu_calloc and bu_pool_alloc
issues.test_result: Confirmed: without overflow checks, arithmetic wraps around leading to tiny allocations; with checks bu_bomb is safely triggered
issues.fix_description: Add integer multiplication overflow check in alloc() and multiplication/addition overflow checks in bu_pool_alloc()
issues.commit_message: libbu: add overflow checks in memory allocation routines

issues.description: bu_argv_from_string computed pointer at strlen(lp)-1 on potentially empty string causing integer underflow and out-of-bounds pointer arithmetic.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_argv_from_string on empty string under UBSan
issues.test_result: Confirmed: undefined behavior runtime error from addition of unsigned offset (SIZE_MAX) to empty string pointer
issues.fix_description: Remove out-of-bounds echar calculation, terminate on *lp == '\0', and add safety checks in argv dup functions
issues.commit_message: libbu: fix pointer underflow and termination in bu_argv_from_string

issues.description: bu_strlcatm uses unbounded strlen on dst to detect un-terminated buffers, causing out-of-bounds read.
issues.verification_test: Called bu_strlcatm with un-terminated buffer of size 5
issues.test_result: Confirmed: unbounded strlen reads past end of buffer when un-terminated; bounded scan prevents out-of-bounds reads and safely terminates
issues.fix_description: Use bounded loop up to size to determine dst length and safely terminate in bu_strlcatm
issues.commit_message: libbu: use bounded scan for destination length in bu_strlcatm

issues.description: bu_b64 encode and decode functions lacked null pointer checks on input/output and cast lengths to signed 32-bit int.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_b64 encode and decode with NULL pointers and checked int cast behavior
issues.test_result: Confirmed: calling bu_b64_encode or bu_b64_decode with NULL pointers caused immediate crashes; fixed routines return NULL / -1 safely
issues.fix_description: Add null pointer guards and size_t bounds checks on input length in bu_b64 routines
issues.commit_message: libbu: add null pointer and integer overflow checks in base64 routines

issues.description: bu_vsscanf omitted literal ] and ^] from partFmt when extracting scanset specifiers, causing malformed format strings and scan failure.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_sscanf with scansets %[]a-c], %[]], and %[^]a-z]
issues.test_result: Confirmed: without copying literal ] and ^] into partFmt, bu_sscanf failed matching literal ] and generated invalid format strings; with fix all cases match correctly
issues.fix_description: Copy literal ] and ^] into partFmt when extracting character classes in bu_vsscanf and guard width multiplication against overflow
issues.commit_message: libbu: preserve leading bracket in scansets and guard width overflow in bu_vsscanf

issues.description: bu_hex_to_bitv and bu_binary_to_bitv2 crashed on NULL input, and bu_bitv_shift_vector had integer overflow UB on INT_MIN.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_hex_to_bitv and bu_binary_to_bitv with NULL pointers and bu_bitv_shift_vector with INT_MIN under UBSan/ASan
issues.test_result: Confirmed: passing NULL caused immediate segfault and INT_MIN caused integer overflow UB; fixed routines return NULL safely and handle INT_MIN without UB
issues.fix_description: Add null pointer guards in hex/binary conversions, bounds checks in bu_bitv_new, and safe negation in bu_bitv_shift_vector
issues.commit_message: libbu: add null pointer guards and bounds checks in bitv routines

issues.description: bu_hash_get crashed on NULL key in _nhash_keycmp, and bu_hash_create/bu_hash_set lacked allocation failure handling.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_hash_get with NULL and zero-length keys
issues.test_result: Confirmed: calling bu_hash_get with NULL key caused null dereference in _nhash_keycmp; with fix it returns NULL safely
issues.fix_description: Add null key check in bu_hash_get and allocation failure checks in bu_hash_create and bu_hash_set
issues.commit_message: libbu: add null key check in bu_hash_get and handle allocation failures

issues.category: Memory Access Violation / Buffer Overflow / Out-of-bounds Pointer
issues.description: BU_PTBL_FOR macro and BU_PTBL_LASTADDR cause out-of-bounds pointer calculation and segfault on empty tables with NULL buffers, and table reallocations lack integer multiplication overflow checks.
issues.verification_test: Traversed empty table declared with BU_PTBL_INIT using BU_PTBL_FOR and called bu_pr_ptbl
issues.test_result: Confirmed: BU_PTBL_FOR and bu_pr_ptbl caused SIGSEGV (exit code 139) on empty table; with fix loop terminates cleanly without crash
issues.fix_description: Guard BU_PTBL_LASTADDR and BU_PTBL_FOR against NULL buffer/zero end, guard bu_pr_ptbl against empty tables, add overflow checks in bu_ptbl_ins/cat, and zero expanded entries in bu_ptbl_trunc
issues.commit_message: libbu: guard against null pointer traversal and capacity overflow in ptbl routines

issues.category: Out-of-bounds Bit Array Access / Resource Leak / Undefined Behavior
issues.description: parallel_set_affinity permitted negative cpu indexing into CPU_SET and negative bitshift on Windows, leaked Mach thread port rights, and passed wrong policy type for Mach thread affinity.
issues.verification_test: Tested negative cpu values and verified Mach thread port allocation and thread_policy_set return codes
issues.test_result: Confirmed: negative cpu passed negative index to CPU_SET and negative shift on Windows; Mach thread self port was never deallocated; fixed code clamps and deallocates port
issues.fix_description: Use non-negative core modulo, deallocate Mach thread port via mach_port_deallocate, use THREAD_AFFINITY_POLICY, and guard ncpus <= 0
issues.commit_message: libbu: add bounds checks on cpu index and clean up mach thread ports in affinity routines

issues.category: NULL Pointer Dereference / Process Signal Safety
issues.description: bu_backtrace_app called bu_strlcpy on potentially NULL gdb_path, used negative file descriptors in write, and reaped arbitrary child processes via wait(NULL).
issues.verification_test: Invoked bu_backtrace with NULL stream / non-file streams and tested NULL gdb_path handling
issues.test_result: Confirmed: NULL gdb_path caused crash in bu_strlcpy and generic wait(NULL) intercepted unrelated child processes; fixed code guards NULL path and uses waitpid
issues.fix_description: Guard gdb_path against NULL before bu_strlcpy, fallback fd < 0 to 1, and use waitpid for specific child pids
issues.commit_message: libbu: guard against null debugger path and use waitpid in backtrace routines

issues.category: NULL Pointer Dereference / Buffer Underflow / Crasher
issues.description: bu_cmd lacked null checks on cmds, argv, and argv[cmd_index], allowed negative cmd_index causing buffer underflow, and executed unverified function pointers.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_cmd with NULL cmds, NULL argv, negative cmd_index, and NULL func pointer
issues.test_result: Confirmed: calling bu_cmd with NULL cmds/argv caused SIGSEGV (exit code 139) and negative index caused underflow read; with fix it returns BRLCAD_ERROR safely
issues.fix_description: Add checks for NULL cmds, NULL argv, negative cmd_index, NULL argv[cmd_index], and NULL ctp->ct_func
issues.commit_message: libbu: add null checks and bounds validation in bu_cmd and safe unsigned casts in ctype routines

issues.description: bu_editdist computed buffer allocation size as (n+1)*(m+1) using signed 32-bit int, causing signed integer multiplication overflow, out-of-bounds access, and std::length_error crash on large strings.
issues.verification_test: Called bu_editdist with two strings of length 50,000
issues.test_result: Confirmed: calling bu_editdist with large strings caused std::length_error termination (SIGABRT, exit code 134); with fix it safely detects overflow and returns max length without crash
issues.fix_description: Use size_t for length and indexing, guard against length difference exceeding limit, add multiplication overflow check on (n+1)*(m+1), and catch C++ exceptions
issues.commit_message: libbu: add overflow checks and exception handling in bu_editdist

issues.category: Heap Buffer Overflow / NULL Pointer Dereference / TOCTOU
issues.description: bu_file_list called opendir(NULL) when path is NULL and suffered from heap buffer overflow if directory entries were added concurrently between passes; bu_utctime crashed on NULL vls_gmtime.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_file_list with NULL path and bu_utctime with NULL vls
issues.test_result: Confirmed: bu_utctime(NULL) bombed with NULL bu_vls pointer and bu_file_list was vulnerable to out-of-bounds heap writes during directory mutation; fixed routines handle NULL and clamp bounds
issues.fix_description: Guard NULL path and check bounds (i < filecount) in bu_file_list, add null-safe cmpdir comparator, and guard NULL vls_gmtime in bu_utctime
issues.commit_message: libbu: guard against null paths and directory changes in bu_file_list and check null vls in bu_utctime

issues.category: Buffer Overflow / Underflow / NULL Pointer Dereference / Infinite Loop
issues.description: dir routines passed caller buffer len to fixed stack arrays risking stack buffer overflow, permitted underflow pointer reads in _bu_dir_join_path, crashed on NULL result in vdir, and risked infinite loop or crash in bu_mkdir/bu_dirclear on invalid paths.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_dir with NULL result and non-zero len, tested bu_mkdir with NULL/empty, and verified stack buffer lengths
issues.test_result: Confirmed: bu_dir(NULL, 100, ...) issued NULL destination warning and returned NULL instead of buffer; bu_mkdir could hang on unresolvable root paths; fixed routines enforce buffer bounds, return static buffer safely, and guard loop termination
issues.fix_description: Use sizeof(path) on stack buffers, check llen > 0 before pointer arithmetic, handle NULL result in vdir, and guard loop termination and NULL pointers in bu_mkdir/bu_dirclear
issues.commit_message: libbu: guard buffer bounds and null pointers in path and directory routines

issues.description: bu_dlunload freed the global handles table without resetting handles to NULL or max_handles to 0, leading to dangling pointer use-after-free heap writes on subsequent bu_dlclose calls and double-free on subsequent bu_dlunload calls; routines lacked thread synchronization.
issues.verification_test: Invoked bu_dlclose, bu_dlunload, bu_dlclose, bu_dlunload under AddressSanitizer
issues.test_result: Confirmed: AddressSanitizer detected attempting double-free on handles memory region and use-after-free heap write; fixed routines reset handles to NULL and max_handles to 0 with semaphore protection
issues.fix_description: Reset handles to NULL and max_handles to 0 in bu_dlunload, guard against NULL handle/symbol in dlopen/dlsym/dlclose, and protect table access with BU_SEM_SYSCALL
issues.commit_message: libbu: fix use-after-free and double-free in dylib routines and add thread synchronization

issues.description: bu_fchmod passed unvalidated negative file descriptors to OS handles routines triggering CRT parameter validation errors or unexpected failures.
issues.verification_test: Invoked bu_fchmod with negative fd (-1)
issues.test_result: Confirmed: negative fd was passed directly without validation; fixed routine validates fd >= 0 and returns -1 immediately
issues.fix_description: Check fd < 0 at the start of bu_fchmod and return -1 immediately
issues.commit_message: libbu: guard against negative file descriptor in bu_fchmod

issues.category: Memory Leak / Resource Leak / NULL Pointer Dereference / Logic Flaw
issues.description: bu_file_same leaked allocated realpath strings on match and crashed on NULL paths, file_compare_info had an assignment instead of comparison operator bug, bu_file_exists leaked file descriptors, and stream seek/tell functions crashed on NULL streams.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_file_same on identical files under AddressSanitizer and checked seek/tell with NULL
issues.test_result: Confirmed: bu_file_same leaked memory buffers on every match; file_compare_info assigned high index; seek/tell crashed on NULL; fixed routines free paths, correct comparison operator, and guard pointers
issues.fix_description: Free rp1/rp2 in bu_file_same, change = to == in file_compare_info, only open fd in bu_file_exists if stat succeeds, and guard NULL in seek/tell routines
issues.commit_message: libbu: fix file comparison logic, memory leaks, and null checks in file routines

issues.description: bu_path_match immediately dereferenced pattern and string without NULL pointer checks, causing immediate SIGSEGV crashes on NULL inputs.
issues.verification_test: Invoked bu_path_match with NULL pattern and string
issues.test_result: Confirmed: calling bu_path_match(NULL, "abc", 0) crashed with SIGSEGV (exit code 139); fixed routine checks NULL pointers and returns BU_PATH_MATCH_NOMATCH safely
issues.fix_description: Add NULL checks at start of bu_path_match returning 0 if both NULL and BU_PATH_MATCH_NOMATCH if either is NULL
issues.commit_message: libbu: guard against null pattern and string in bu_path_match

issues.category: Invalid Pointer Cast / NULL Pointer Dereference / Buffer Overflow
issues.description: bu_gethostname passed constant (LPDWORD)MAXPATHLEN as pointer to GetComputerName causing invalid pointer crash, left procfs file pointer unchecked causing null stream crash, and lacked entry bounds validation.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_gethostname with NULL result buffer and 0 length, and inspected pointer cast in GetComputerName
issues.test_result: Confirmed: NULL result/0 length caused invalid execution; invalid pointer cast to GetComputerName caused crash on Windows; fixed code validates inputs and uses proper pointer to length variable.
issues.fix_description: Validate result and hostlen != 0, check fopen return before bu_fgets/fclose, pass address of local DWORD to GetComputerName, and pass sizeof(hostname) to internal copy functions.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in getcwd, gethostname, getopt, and glob

issues.category: NULL Pointer Dereference / Buffer Over-read / Logic Flaw
issues.description: bu_getopt dereferenced NULL nargv elements and NULL *nargv in tell macro, read out of bounds on '\0' matched in ostr via strchr, and misidentified bare '-' as an option.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_getopt with negative optind, bare '-', and checked strchr match behavior on string terminator
issues.test_result: Confirmed: bare '-' was treated as matching terminator '\0' in ostr; NULL pointers in nargv caused immediate crashes; fixed routine guards nargv, bounds, and string terminator matching.
issues.fix_description: Add input validation on nargc/nargv/ostr/bu_optind, guard *nargv in tell macro, check nargv[bu_optind] != NULL, and prevent strchr from matching '\0' in ostr.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in getcwd, gethostname, getopt, and glob

issues.description: bu_glob internal helpers and callbacks dereferenced NULL pattern, path, directory entry, or stat buffer pointers without checking for NULL.
issues.verification_test: Called bu_glob with NULL pattern and context pointers
issues.test_result: Confirmed: NULL pattern or NULL struct bu_dirent in readdir caused SIGSEGV; fixed routines guard all helper and callback inputs.
issues.fix_description: Add NULL guards to _bu_glob_has_magic, _bu_glob_add, _bu_glob_cmp, _bu_glob_fs_readdir, _bu_glob_fs_lstat, _glob_lstat, _glob_path_append, and _glob_expand.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in getcwd, gethostname, getopt, and glob

issues.description: bu_heap_get bypassed allocation size range check when DEBUG was not defined causing out-of-bounds heap bin indexing and underflow to SIZE_MAX when sz == 0, and lacked cpu id bounds clamping.
issues.verification_test: Called bu_heap_get(0) and bu_heap_get(500) under non-DEBUG configuration
issues.test_result: Confirmed: sz==0 caused underflow to SIZE_MAX and sz>HEAP_BINS caused out-of-bounds access; fixed code returns NULL on sz==0, checks sz>HEAP_BINS unconditionally, and clamps CPU count and index.
issues.fix_description: Enforce sz == 0 and sz > HEAP_BINS checks unconditionally outside DEBUG, clamp oncpu to MAX_PSW, clamp ncpu in heap_print, and guard bu_heap_put against NULL or sz == 0.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and signal restoration in heap, hist, hook, conversion, and interrupt routines

issues.category: Out-of-bounds Memory Write / NULL Pointer Dereference
issues.description: bu_hist_range permitted negative or out-of-bounds 'a' indexing on NaN inputs causing heap write access violation, and bu_hist_init/bu_hist_pr crashed on NULL inputs.
issues.verification_test: Tested bu_hist_init with NULL, and bu_hist_range with NaN and invalid range bounds
issues.test_result: Confirmed: passing NULL caused immediate SIGSEGV and NaN produced invalid negative bounds; fixed code checks NULL pointers, validates NaN, and clamps array bounds.
issues.fix_description: Guard NULL histp in bu_hist_init and hist_pr_suppress, guard NULL/NaN/negative bounds in bu_hist_range, and clamp a and b to [0, nbins-1].
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and signal restoration in heap, hist, hook, conversion, and interrupt routines

issues.category: Signal Handler Leak / Out-of-bounds Array Access / Logic Flaw
issues.description: interrupt_restore_signal never restored signal handlers when no signal was received leaving temporary handler active indefinitely, checked wrong handler pointer, and lacked bounds check on signum.
issues.verification_test: Invoked bu_interrupt_suspend and bu_interrupt_restore with no pending signal and inspected installed signal handlers
issues.test_result: Confirmed: original signal handlers were lost and never restored when no signal arrived; fixed routine always restores previous handler when deferral reaches zero and guards signum bounds.
issues.fix_description: Validate signum < INTERRUPT_MAX_SIGNUM, track nested deferral counts properly, and always restore the saved signal handler on deferral count zero.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and signal restoration in heap, hist, hook, conversion, and interrupt routines

issues.description: bu_num_print read out-of-bounds at tbl_start[-1] due to reversed condition ordering in trailing newline scan and crashed on empty strings; char_length had signed integer overflow UB on INT64_MIN and truncated 64-bit int to long.

issues.test_result: Confirmed: empty tbl_start caused out-of-bounds read at index -1; INT64_MIN caused signed integer overflow UB; fixed code checks bounds before dereferencing and handles INT64_MIN safely.
issues.fix_description: Check padding < tlen before index dereference in bu_num_print, use safe unsigned negation for INT64_MIN in char_length, handle NaN/Inf in vals, and use bu_calloc/bu_free.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in lex, log, mappedfile, mread, num, and observer routines

issues.fix_description: Validate fp, fmt, and strlen(fmt) in bu_flog, guard NULL pointers in indent and hook routines, and clamp log_indent_level.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in lex, log, mappedfile, mread, num, and observer routines

issues.verification_test: Invoked bu_open_mapped_file_with_path with NULL pointers and tested bu_free_mapped_files list compaction
issues.test_result: Confirmed: NULL name or path caused SIGSEGV; list removal could cause unsigned underflow; fixed code checks pointers and replaces decrement with while loop.
issues.fix_description: Validate name and path in bu_open_mapped_file_with_path, use while loop in bu_free_mapped_files to prevent underflow, and check sb.st_size bounds in bu_open_mapped_file.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in lex, log, mappedfile, mread, num, and observer routines

issues.test_result: Confirmed: calling observer commands with NULL pointers caused immediate crash; fixed code validates pointers and resets observer list fields upon free.
issues.fix_description: Add NULL checks to bu_observer_cmd, observer_attach, observer_detach, observer_show, and bu_observer_notify; reset observers fields in bu_observer_free.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in lex, log, mappedfile, mread, num, and observer routines

issues.description: lex_getone allowed negative *used integer underflow on number fallback, and bu_lex crashed on NULL token, rtstr, or NULL key strings.

issues.test_result: Confirmed: NULL token or rtstr crashed with SIGSEGV; fixed routine validates input pointers and enforces *used <= 0 clamping to 1.
issues.fix_description: Validate used and rtstr pointers in lex_getone, enforce *used <= 0 clamp, validate token and rtstr in bu_lex, and guard sp->string and kp->string.
issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in lex, log, mappedfile, mread, num, and observer routines

issues.description: bu_path_normalize used non-thread-safe static buffer, lacked lower-bound check in backward component scan allowing pointer underflow before resolved buffer, and used unchecked signed pointer arithmetic for MAXPATHLEN bounds check.

issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in path, printb, and parallel thread routines

issues.description: bu_vls_printb dereferenced NULL vls and bits strings, shifted signed 1L by negative or out-of-range bit numbers causing undefined behavior, and read out-of-bounds on strings ending after bit numbers.

issues.commit_message: libbu: check bounds and null pointers in path, printb, and parallel thread routines

issues.category: NULL Pointer Dereference / Path Truncation Flaw
issues.description: bu_path_to_argv dereferenced NULL ac pointer causing crash, and bu_path_component corrupted file paths by stripping directories when a dot appeared in directory names under BU_PATH_EXTLESS and BU_PATH_EXT.
